title: Another Saudi Surprise
summary: Will the OPEC+ production cut work this time? As our regular readers may recall, we just wrote a Weekly Tanker Opinion about OPEC production cuts on April 7 (" OPEC Cuts And Tankers Tank "). Today, barely two months later we find ourselves talking about it again.
